name: agy-bridge-dev
description: Development build of the agy bridge: runs your working copy on disk, so edits need only a server restart.
long_description: Identical to the agy bridge extension except that it loads the server from a file you point it at rather than from a copy inside the bundle. Install this while iterating on the bridge, and the packaged build for normal use. Do not enable both at once — they expose the same tool names.

dev_entry.title: Bridge source file
dev_entry.description: Your working copy of agy-bridge.mjs. This file is read at server start, so edits take effect on the next restart.

wsl_distro.title: WSL distro
wsl_distro.description: Distro where agy is installed and logged in (`wsl -l -q`). Leave empty on macOS/Linux or for a native Windows agy.

allowed_roots.title: Allowed write roots
allowed_roots.description: Colon-separated directories Gemini may write in, as the machine running agy sees them.

tools.name: delegate
tools.description: Run a coding task on a Gemini model via agy; supports plan mode; returns a digest plus the git diffstat

tools.name: help
tools.description: Discover this agy install's flags and slash commands

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check binary, auth path and bridge configuration
